title: Responsive Vehicle and System Performance
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise responsive vehicle performance and easy-to-use responsive features, while a few fragments are too unclear or concern other issues to assign sentiment about responsiveness.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight a responsive driving feel, accurate or well-functioning systems, and straightforward responsive service interactions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention a requested feature, persistent warning chimes, or cooling performance, but they do not provide enough clear evidence about responsiveness as a topic.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 reviews.
Several fragments are very short or only loosely connected to responsiveness, which limits topic coherence.
The topic mixes vehicle responsiveness, feature responsiveness, service responsiveness, and unrelated comfort or warning issues.
